post.caption: This diamond sold for over $48 million. It is the Blue Moon of Josephine, at 12.03 carats. GIA graded it Fancy Vivid blue and Internally Flawless, and boron in the diamond is what makes it blue. Its 29.62-carat rough came from South Africa's Cullinan mine in 2014, and Cora International paid about $25.6 million for that rough. Cora then spent months cutting and polishing it. Sotheby's sold it in Geneva in November 2015. With fees, the price was close to $48.5 million, which is over $4 million a carat, an auction record. The buyer renamed it for his daughter Josephine, then seven.
